scripts.build: tsc -p tsconfig.build.json && node --input-type=commonjs -e "const fs = require('node:fs'); const { name, version, type, exports } = require('./package.json'); exports['.'] = { types: './index.d.ts', default: './index.js' }; fs.writeFileSync('dist/package.json', JSON.stringify({ name, version, type, private: true, exports, files: ['index.js', 'index.d.ts', 'fixtures/manifest-conformance.json'] }, null, 2) + '\n'); fs.copyFileSync('README.md', 'dist/README.md'); fs.cpSync('fixtures', 'dist/fixtures', { recursive: true });"
